visual.text: Your child already loves games. Let them build one.
Free weekend coding for Primary 3 to 6, taught by teenagers who remember being beginners.
A girl of about ten points excitedly at a laptop screen, where a cartoon cat she has made is jumping. Beside her, a teenage tutor sits back with his hands off the keyboard, smiling.

Byte Buddies is run by secondary school students who learnt to code the hard way: by getting stuck, a lot. That is why our tutors never take over the mouse. They ask questions, give hints and wait. Over eight Saturdays, your child will plan, build and share a simple game of their own — and learn that a mistake is just a puzzle to solve.

items: Does my child need a laptop? No. We lend one.
Is it safe? A teacher-adviser is in the room at every session.
